title: Daande Jokkondirnde e Koɗli
intro: Ruuhu peewɗo rokkaama dokke keewɗe ummoraade e asamaan, wonti laamɗo e jaambaaro mo sifaa mum tigi wayi ko no jokkondirɗo e tagoore ndee e hoore mum. Daartol maɓɓe ina weeɓi e nder annabaaku, e laamaandi, e karallaagal, ina acci lefol ngol ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder kelle peeñgol Alla.
clues: Mi suɓaama ngam wonde maccuɗo Alla, mi rokkaama laamu tiiɗngu e nder leñol cuɓaaɗo.
Koye e colli ina njirloo e am e teddinde Toowɗo.
Njamndi softii no loopal nii e juuɗe am, ko yiɗde Alla tan.
Mi waɗii balɗe kaɓtorɗe kaɓtorɗe konunkooɓe e nder nguleeki hare.
Mi meeɗii yahde e jarribo caɗtungo nde luutndiiɓe ɗiɗo njani e nokku am dewal tawa mi sikkaano.
Mi siftinaama e sara laamcfo yamiroowo henndu e jinneeji — sabu oon laamcfo ko 6icfcfo am tigi.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
